name: Dell PowerStore MCP Server
description: Enables AI assistants and automation platforms to interact with Dell PowerStore storage arrays by dynamically generating over 260 tools from OpenAPI specifications. It features a credential-free architecture for secure, multi-host management of storage, networking, and system health.
